slice: Wiring and electrical system from the owner's service manual: Yamaha YZ250F 2024 (wiring pass 2026-11)

records.statement: Yamaha's wire colour letters on the 2024 YZ250F: B black, Br brown, Dl dark blue, G green, Gy gray, L blue, P pink, R red, Sb sky blue, W white, Y yellow, Lg light green. Two letters with a slash mean a base colour with a stripe, so B/W is black with a white stripe, R/W red with white, L/B blue with black, Br/W brown with white, Y/W yellow with white.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Electrical components on the wiring diagram
records.statement: The 2024 YZ250F electrical system has these parts: crankshaft position sensor, AC magneto (stator), rectifier/regulator, battery (lithium-ion), one main fuse, starter relay, starter motor, a diode, the CCU (communication control unit, the wireless link for the tuning app), the ECU (which has the lean angle sensor built in), ignition coil, fuel injector, fuel pump, intake air temperature sensor, coolant temperature sensor, throttle position sensor, intake air pressure sensor, gear position switch, the left handlebar switch (indicator lights, mode switch and engine stop switch) and the start switch on the right. Engine ground and frame ground are separate points. There is no key switch and no separate tip-over sensor.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Charging circuit wiring and test values
records.statement: Charging on the 2024 YZ250F: the AC magneto sends two white leads to the rectifier/regulator. The regulator output is red at the unit and red/white in the harness, running to the main fuse at the starter relay; its black lead goes to engine ground. Test: with the engine at about 5000 r/min, measure between red/white (+) and black (-) at the rectifier/regulator coupler: 14.0 to 14.8 V DC; outside that, replace the rectifier/regulator. Stator test: check continuity between the two white leads at the stator coupler; no continuity means replace the stator assembly.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.notes: Read from the wiring diagram; check the diagram on the bike before cutting, splicing or back-probing.

records.topic: Battery, main fuse and power feed
records.statement: The 2024 YZ250F has one 15 A main fuse (plus one 15 A spare), at the starter relay under the left side cover. Power path: battery positive (red) to the starter relay; regulator output (red/white) into the fuse; red/yellow out of the fuse to a joint that feeds red leads to the ECU, ignition coil, fuel injector, fuel pump and CCU, the red/blue feed to the indicator lights and the brown/white feed to the starter relay coil. Battery negative (black) goes to frame ground. The battery is lithium-ion: 13.25 V or more at rest is normal; between 10 V and 13.25 V charge it with the specified lithium charger and re-check; under 10 V replace it. A new battery ships in sleep mode and can read about 0.1 V until its first charge; that is not a fault. Never use a lead-acid charger or let charging exceed 16 V.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.statement: Starting circuit on the 2024 YZ250F: the start switch on the right handlebar has a blue/black lead and a black lead to ground. Pressing it grounds blue/black, which pulls in the starter relay coil (fed by brown/white from the fused joint); a diode sits between brown/white and blue/black. The same blue/black wire also runs to the ECU. The relay then connects battery positive to the starter motor, which grounds through the engine. To test the motor alone, the manual jumps battery positive straight to the starter motor lead with a heavy jumper; if it does not turn, the motor is at fault. Wait at least 10 seconds between start attempts.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Ignition circuit wiring and test values
records.statement: Ignition on the 2024 YZ250F: the crankshaft position sensor has gray and black leads (white/black and black in the harness, white/black to the ECU). The ignition coil gets power on red and is switched by the ECU on white. Tests with the couplers unplugged: crankshaft position sensor 228 to 342 ohms between gray and black; ignition coil primary 1.98 to 2.42 ohms; secondary 14.64 to 21.96 kilohms; spark plug cap 7.50 to 12.50 kilohms; minimum spark gap on a spark checker 6.0 mm. Idle speed is 1900 to 2100 r/min. The engine stop switch and the lean angle sensor inside the ECU both kill the ignition.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Fuel injection sensors: wiring and test values
records.statement: Sensor wiring and tests on the 2024 YZ250F. Fuel injector: red (power) and red/black (ECU), 12.0 ohms. Fuel pump: red (power) and black/yellow (ECU). Intake air temperature sensor: brown/white and black/blue, 5400 to 6600 ohms at 0 C (32 F) and 290 to 390 ohms at 80 C (176 F). Coolant temperature sensor: green and black, 2513 to 2777 ohms at 20 C (68 F) and 210 to 221 ohms at 100 C (212 F). Throttle position sensor: blue (5 V supply), yellow (signal) and black (ground); input voltage 4 to 6 V between blue and black with the test harness fitted. Intake air pressure sensor: blue (supply), white (signal) and black (ground). The sensors share the black/blue sensor ground back to the ECU. After replacing the throttle position sensor or the ECU, reset the ECU with diagnostic code 87 on the Yamaha diagnostic tool.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Handlebar switches, indicator lights and gear position switch wiring
records.statement: On the 2024 YZ250F the left handlebar switch coupler carries black/red, black/brown, red/blue, black, yellow/white and green/black. Red/blue feeds the two indicator lights, which the ECU switches on black/brown and black/red. The mode switch connects yellow/white to ground when pushed, and the engine stop switch connects green/black to ground when pushed. The gear position switch has pink, sky blue and yellow/white leads (yellow/black at the ECU) and is checked for continuity in each gear. The CCU connects on brown, light green/white, light green/blue, black/white (ground) and red (power).

records.statement: Fault codes on the 2024 YZ250F (shown by the indicator light or the Yamaha diagnostic tool): 8 gear position switch open or short; 12 no normal signal from the crankshaft position sensor; 13 intake air pressure sensor open or short; 14 intake air pressure sensor hose clogged or detached; 15 throttle position sensor open or short; 16 throttle position sensor stuck; 21 coolant temperature sensor open or short; 22 intake air temperature sensor open or short; 30 the bike has overturned; 33 ignition coil primary lead open or short; 39 injector open or short; 41 lean angle sensor fault inside the ECU; 43 fuel system voltage wrong at the CCU; 44 EEPROM read or write error; 46 normal voltage not reaching the ECU; 50 faulty ECU memory; 70 engine stopped itself after idling too long.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: Diagnostic tool readings for a healthy bike
records.statement: Reference readings on the Yamaha diagnostic tool for the 2024 YZ250F: throttle angle (code 01) reads 11 to 14 fully closed and 86 to 92 fully open; the lean angle sensor (code 08) reads 0.4 to 1.4 V upright and 3.7 to 4.4 V when the ECU is tilted 45 degrees or more; code 03 shows intake air pressure, 05 intake air temperature and 06 coolant temperature, each compared against a real measurement. The lean angle sensor is part of the ECU, so the ECU has to stay mounted in its original position to work correctly.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram

records.topic: How to probe connectors without damaging them
records.statement: Yamaha's rule for electrical checks on the 2024 YZ250F: never push tester probes into the terminal slots on the mating face of a coupler. Probe from the back of the coupler where the wires enter, without loosening the leads. When checking a switch for continuity, work it back and forth a few times. If a new fuse blows straight away, find the fault in the circuit; never fit a fuse of a higher rating. Disconnect the battery negative lead first and reconnect it last.

source.name: Yamaha 2024 YZ250F owner's service manual (BMF-2819U-10), chapter 8 and wiring diagram
